name: Robot Dev AI M14
description: Precision product surface for a safe virtual-robot workflow.

motion.reduced: All animation and transitions reduce to 0.01ms.

principles: Use the bright product surface for planning and review; reserve deep ink for runtime evidence.
Signal blue is an activation and focus color, not decoration.
One primary action per decision area; confirmations remain explicit.
Design for keyboard use and a no-horizontal-scroll compact layout.
